project_context.name: eXceeders Landing Page
project_context.description: Premium landing page for eXceeders, a B2B digital transformation & managed IT services company.
project_context.tone: Modern, sophisticated, technology-focused, premium, clean, spacious, trustworthy
project_context.theme_strategy: Hybrid theme - Light backgrounds for header/hero to support the provided dark logo, alternating with deep dark blue gradients for high-impact sections (Stats, Footer) to utilize the brand palette effectively.

primary_foundation.description: Dark Blue Gradient. Use for structural sections, high-impact stats, and footer.

typography.import_instructions: Import 'Manrope' from Google Fonts and set it as the sans font family in tailwind.config.js.

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter leading-tight

assets.logo_specs: Dark version on light bg (navy text, green X). MUST be placed on light/white background for visibility.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Sections must breathe.

header.layout: Flexbox, logo left, nav links center/right, CTA right.
header.links: Home (active), CIO Plus, Talent Plus, Support Plus, Dev Plus, Project Plus
header.cta: Pill-shaped, bg-primary-emerald text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 hover:shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20

hero.layout: Grid cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-16 items-center min-h-[90vh]
hero.visual: Animated network/nodes diagram. CREATE THIS WITH SVG + FRAMER MOTION. Do NOT use stock photos. Draw interconnected nodes (circles) in Primary Emerald and Sea tones with glowing opacity, lines connecting them, and pulse animations.

trusted_by.style: Monochrome logos in a subtle infinite scrolling marquee. Use react-fast-marquee or CSS animations.

stats_row.cards: Flat design, 1px border-metal/50, rounded-2xl, p-8. Use Framer Motion 'useInView' to animate counters from 0 to target (30, 90, 99).

services_ways_we_help.card_style: Neumorphic/Crisp hybrid. bg-white, 1px border-metal, rounded-2xl, p-10. Hover: -translate-y-2, shadow-xl, border-pistachio. Include Lucide icons colored in Sea/Emerald.

process_why_our_model_wins.layout: Horizontal timeline on desktop, vertical on mobile.
process_why_our_model_wins.visuals: 4-step connected diagram. Use a dashed SVG line connecting 4 circular nodes. Animate the line filling up (stroke-dashoffset) on scroll.

our_network_stats.typography: text-welcome-white with accents in pistachio and sea.
our_network_stats.decorative: Add a subtle grain overlay or very faint Welcome Pine (#07404B) glowing orbs in background.

audience_who_else.card_style: Solid white cards, top border in primary_emerald. Icon-driven.

final_cta.buttons: Primary: bg-primary-emerald text-white. Secondary: border-2 border-secondary-blue text-secondary-blue bg-transparent hover:bg-secondary-blue hover:text-white.

footer.logo_handling: Since background is dark and logo is dark, place logo in a white rounded rectangle or highly visible container.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up for all section children using Framer Motion (initial={{opacity:0, y:30}} whileInView={{opacity:1, y:0}} viewport={{once:true}}).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must scale to 1.05 and adjust shadow. Service cards lift on hover.
motion_and_interactions.network_diagram: Use Framer Motion to infinitely animate x/y coordinates of SVG circles (nodes) slightly to simulate floating/breathing.

development_rules.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, cards) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
development_rules.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios. Use APCA guidelines. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds behind text. Explicit hover/focus states.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You are E1, a Creative Designer. Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics (no purple/violet generic gradients, no boring centered text blocks without contrast).
Strictly adhere to the brand colors provided. Do not invent new hex codes. Dark blue gradient is the foundation; Emerald is the action color.
DO NOT USE STOCK PHOTOS for the diagrams or cards. Use SVG-based custom art or Lucide React icons.
Ensure 'Book a Consultation' and 'Explore Our Services' buttons do nothing (dead placeholders) but look fully interactive.
If the header is sticky, ensure it has a solid or highly-blurred background to maintain logo and link legibility over content.
Never center-align large blocks of body text; only center headers or short CTA snippets.
For 'Page Coming Soon' links, attach a simple toast notification (using sonner) instead of actual routing.
